scripts.check: bun install --frozen-lockfile && biome check . && vitest run && bun test hooks/

BUCKET.description: The R2 bucket this CDN serves. Every path on the Worker streams an object out of it, and `POST /api/upload` is the only way in.

CDN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the file explorer at `/`. Object URLs stay public — this gates the browse/upload/delete UI only.

CDN_SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs the explorer's session cookie. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Changing it signs everyone out.

CDN_UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for `POST /api/upload` — how scripts, CLIs and hooks write. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`; keep it separate from your password.

CDN_PURGE_TOKEN.description: **Optional, leave blank.** A [Cloudflare API token](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) scoped to *Zone → Cache Purge*, so an overwritten file goes stale on every edge POP at once. Only useful once you have added a custom domain — see the README.
